description: Turn a night out you have planned with someone (or a few days out) into a Manchester Tonight plan: a link that opens the plan on manchestertonight.co.uk, where they can change it and send it to friends on WhatsApp, plus the message text. Find the stops first with whats_on or search_listings. Listed venues get their area and page filled in, and a stop with no time gets the start time of the night on at that venue that day. The first stop each day is where everyone meets. Give the plan an intro and each stop a blurb, written to the person's friends: what you'll do there, why it's a good pick, and anything to book, bring or know (opening times, dietary notes, tickets). Returns a short link that previews as a card with the plan's name, a full message and a short one; offer whichever suits (the short one or just the link is best for a group chat). The plan is kept only to serve that link, until a month after its last day.

date.description: The night, or the first day: tonight, tomorrow, a weekday name, YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY (UK time).

end_date.description: Optional last day, for a plan over several days (up to 14), in the same formats.

intro.description: Optional few sentences to everyone about the plan, e.g. "Birthday week! Rough plan below, come to whatever you can."

stops.description: The stops in order. On a plan over several days, give each stop its day.

blurb.description: A sentence or two for friends about this stop: what you'll do, why it's a good pick, anything to book, bring or know.

cost.description: Optional cost per person as text, e.g. "£5" or "Free".

day.description: Which day, for a plan over several days: a date or weekday name within the dates.

note.description: Older name for blurb; use blurb.

place.description: Venue or place name, e.g. "Frog & Bucket". Places that aren't listed are fine.

what.description: Optional: what they are doing there, e.g. "Pub quiz" or "Dinner".

title.description: Optional name, e.g. "Sam's birthday". Default "Night out".

name: plan_night_out
title: Make a night-out plan to share
